title: TRIPWIRE: A Dataset of Install-Time Environment Gates in Malicious npm and PyPI Packages
description:
Install-time environment gates in malicious npm and PyPI packages: for each campaign representative, every condition a package tests before its payload runs (API, compared value, boolean structure, smallest set that must hold together, environment recipe per branch), with hashed byte anchors into the package, member and skip records for denominators, verification verdicts from a deterministic checker and LLM reviewers, and the tools that rebuild every table without the malware. No malware is included.

Data (reports/, dataset/) and schemas: CC BY 4.0. Code: Apache-2.0.
